name: Avacyn's Spear
description: Avacyn's broken-tipped spear, too holy for most to touch, which Thalia wields with Traft's power.

description_citations.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
description_citations.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Thalia's party meets Rem Karolus, who carries Avacyn's broken spear and confirms she is dead.
timeline.quote: Even with its tip broken in a jagged line, Avacyn's spear was unmistakable.

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Thalia's hand is burned by holy light when she tries to touch the spear.
timeline.quote: A flare of holy light erupted where her hand touched the metal haft

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: With Saint Traft's power, Thalia lifts the spear and mounts it on her saddle as the order's banner.
timeline.quote: We ride under this banner now,

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: With Saint Traft's help, Thalia lifts Avacyn's spear and is given glowing angelic wings.
timeline.quote: glowing, translucent wings spread out from her back, the blessing of some unseen angel.

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Thalia drives Avacyn's spear through the angel-thing's back and into its spine.
timeline.quote: she drove Avacyn's spear through feathered wings and buried it deep into the spine

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.
